name: White Silence
source:
You play as Hale, a clerk stranded after the Terra Nova Expedition goes wrong. Each day, you choose how to survive. But the longer you last, the harder it becomes to tell what’s real – and what remains of you in the white.

[From [url=https://quill-studio.itch.io/white-silence]Itch.io[/url]]
